readings: Matching risk/margin records to orders (`ordervault` = `recordvault`) and dropping those without a match, count the risk/margin records for each order type (`ordertune`), so an order with two risk/margin records counts twice. Then, for the types whose count is above the average count across types, give one row with the average of their counts and the average amount by which their counts exceed that average, unrounded.
queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c
)
SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess
FROM c, a
WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt
